items.statement: The report independently inventories chemically explicit first-event hypotheses and records advancement, merging or rejection reasons.
items.expected: Hypothesis classes and disposition reasons are explicit; no unsupported discovery claim is used.

items.statement: Advanced candidates retain state identity, atom balance, charge, spin and conformer/water-placement validation with a stopping rationale.
items.expected: Per-candidate validation and coverage/stopping evidence are present.

items.statement: For the source-supported stepwise PT and ET classes, dry first-event values are approximately -0.9 and -1.6 kcal/mol, respectively.
items.expected: If these classes are investigated, the corresponding values are near the published values and state identity is retained.

items.statement: Explicit water substantially stabilizes the source-supported electron-transfer first-event class, with a published value near -8.2 kcal/mol.
items.expected: Evaluate computed hydrated ET thermodynamics when that class is investigated, preserving state identity and the -8.2 kcal/mol source context. An uncomputed value earns no result credit.
